diff --git a/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py b/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py
index 421f3ae..704b95b 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ BindingEvent = namedtuple('BindingEvent', [
     'initializer_ended', 'root_separator',
 ])
 BindingSummary = namedtuple('BindingSummary', [
-    'defaults', 'expression_complexity', 'confirmed_defaults',
+    'defaults', 'expression_complexity', 'confirmed_defaults', 'names',
 ])
 
 
@@ -28,6 +28,10 @@ class JavaScriptBindings:
         self._expression_brackets = []
         self.previous = ''
         self.defaults = 0
+        # The first name of each element: the parameters, if "=>" follows.
+        self.names = []
+        self._name_expected = True
+        self._type_brackets = None
 
     @property
     def in_expression(self):
@@ -50,6 +54,7 @@ class JavaScriptBindings:
         root_separator = (token == ',' and len(self._frames) == 1
                           and not self._expression_brackets)
         defaults = self.defaults
+        self._read_name(token, initializing, root_separator)
         if self._expression_brackets:
             if token in self.BRACKETS:
                 self._expression_brackets.append(self.BRACKETS[token])
@@ -76,6 +81,22 @@ class JavaScriptBindings:
         return BindingEvent(ended, initializing, self.defaults != defaults,
                             initializer_ended, root_separator)
 
+    def _read_name(self, token, initializing, root_separator):
+        in_expression = initializing or self._expression_brackets
+        if root_separator and not self._type_brackets:
+            self._name_expected = True
+            self._type_brackets = None
+        elif self._type_brackets is not None:
+            # A type annotation, whose type arguments may contain commas.
+            self._type_brackets += {'<': 1, '>': -1}.get(token, 0)
+        elif token == ':' and len(self._frames) == 1 and not in_expression:
+            self._type_brackets = 0
+        elif self._name_expected and not in_expression:
+            name = token.rstrip('?')
+            if name.replace('$', '_').isidentifier():
+                self.names.append(name)
+                self._name_expected = False
+
 
 class JavaScriptBindingsMixin:
     """Keep provisional bindings with the function that owns their CCN."""
@@ -97,7 +118,8 @@ class JavaScriptBindingsMixin:
                 self._confirmed_binding_defaults += pending.defaults
             else:
                 self.context.add_condition(pending.defaults)
-        elif token == '=>':
+        elif token in ('=>', ':'):
+            # The colon may start the return type of an arrow function.
             self._pending_bindings = pending
         else:
             self.context.add_condition(pending.confirmed_defaults)
@@ -114,7 +136,8 @@ class JavaScriptBindingsMixin:
             summary = BindingSummary(
                 candidate._binding_candidate.defaults,
                 function.cyclomatic_complexity - complexity if track_complexity else 0,
-                candidate._confirmed_binding_defaults if track_complexity else 0)
+                candidate._confirmed_binding_defaults if track_complexity else 0,
+                candidate._binding_candidate.names)
             if callback:
                 callback(summary)
             else:
@@ -132,8 +155,18 @@ class JavaScriptBindingsMixin:
             self.context.add_condition(-pending.expression_complexity)
         self._push_function_to_stack()
         if pending:
+            for i, name in enumerate(pending.names):
+                if i:
+                    self.context.parameter(',')
+                self.context.parameter(name)
             self.context.add_condition(pending.defaults + pending.expression_complexity)
 
+    def _read_arrow(self):
+        name = self.last_token or ''
+        if not self._pending_bindings and name.replace('$', '_').isidentifier():
+            # The parameter of "x => x", which has no parentheses.
+            self._pending_bindings = BindingSummary(0, 0, 0, [name])
+
     def _read_parameter_binding(self, token):
         event = self._parameter_bindings.read_token(token)
         if event.initializer_started:
diff --git a/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py b/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py
index 6eedba1..b4a7667 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py
@@ -88,6 +88,7 @@ class TypeScriptStates(JavaScriptBindingsMixin, JavaScriptFunctionsMixin,
         elif token in ('else', 'do', 'try', 'final'):
             self.next(self._expecting_statement_or_block)
         elif token in ('=>',):
+            self._read_arrow()
             self._state = self._arrow_function
         elif token == '=':
             # Only set function_name for valid identifiers
@@ -112,7 +113,7 @@ class TypeScriptStates(JavaScriptBindingsMixin, JavaScriptFunctionsMixin,
                 if (self.last_tokens != self.function_name
                         and self._prev_token not in ('=', 'async', '>')):
                     self.function_name = ''
-                    self.sub_state(self.__class__(self.context))
+                    self._read_binding_candidate(')')
                 else:
                     if not self.started_function:
                         self._function(self.function_name)
diff --git a/test/test_languages/testES6.py b/test/test_languages/testES6.py
index 850e0b7..d9badbd 100644
--- a/test/test_languages/testES6.py
+++ b/test/test_languages/testES6.py
@@ -511,3 +511,44 @@ class Test_ES6_multiple_arrow_patterns(unittest.TestCase):
         functions = get_js_function_list(code)
         self.assertEqual(["validate"], [f.name for f in functions])
         self.assertGreater(functions[0].cyclomatic_complexity, 1)
+
+
+class Test_ES6_arrow_function_parameters(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def parameter_counts(self, code, filename="a.js"):
+        return [(f.name, f.parameter_count) for f in
+                analyze_file.analyze_source_code(filename, code).function_list]
+
+    def test_anonymous_arrow_functions(self):
+        code = (
+            "list.map((x, i) => x + i);\n"
+            "list.filter((x) => { return x; });\n"
+            "list.forEach((_, key) => { selected.add(key); });\n"
+            "list.sort(({a}, [b, c] = [], ...rest) => { return a; });\n"
+            "run(() => { return 1; });\n"
+            "const eq = strict ? (a, b) => { return a === b; } : null;\n"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual([('(anonymous)', 2), ('(anonymous)', 1),
+                          ('(anonymous)', 2), ('(anonymous)', 3),
+                          ('(anonymous)', 0), ('(anonymous)', 2)],
+                         self.parameter_counts(code))
+
+    def test_arrow_functions_without_parentheses(self):
+        code = (
+            "const f = x => { return x; };\n"
+            "const g = async x => { return x; };\n"
+            "list.map(x => { return x * 2; });\n"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual([('f', 1), ('g', 1), ('(anonymous)', 1)],
+                         self.parameter_counts(code))
+
+    def test_anonymous_arrow_function_with_types(self):
+        code = (
+            "list.map((x: number, i: Map<K, V>) => { return x + i; });\n"
+            "list.map((x?: number): number => { return x; });\n"
+            "list.map((x, y): Map<K, V> => { return x; });\n"
+        )
+        for filename in ("a.ts", "a.tsx"):
+            self.assertEqual([('(anonymous)', 2), ('(anonymous)', 1),
+                              ('(anonymous)', 2)],
+                             self.parameter_counts(code, filename), filename)
